function apply(fn: (x: string) => void): void;
function apply(fn: (x: number, y: number) => void): void;
function apply(fn: any) { fn(2, 3); }
apply(
  (x = 1, y: number) => console.log(x + y)
);

function another(fn: (x: number) => void): void;
function another(fn: (x: string, y: number) => void): void;
function another(fn: any) { fn('a', 3); }
another(
  (x = 'a', y: number) => console.log(x.repeat(y))
);

const empty: [] = [];
apply(
  (x = 1, y: number) => console.log(x + y),
  ...empty
);

function prefixed(tag: number, fn: (x: string) => void): void;
function prefixed(tag: number, fn: (x: number, y: number) => void): void;
function prefixed(tag: number, fn: any) { fn(tag, 3); }
const prefix: [number] = [2];
prefixed(
  ...prefix,
  (x = 1, y: number) => console.log(x + y)
);

function objectCall(value: { run: (x: string) => void }): void;
function objectCall(value: { run: (x: number, y: number) => void }): void;
function objectCall(value: any) { value.run(2, 3); }
objectCall({ run: (x = 1, y: number) => console.log(x + y) });
objectCall({ run(x = 1, y: number) { console.log(x + y); } });

function tupleCall(value: [(x: string) => void]): void;
function tupleCall(value: [(x: number, y: number) => void]): void;
function tupleCall(value: any) { value[0](2, 3); }
tupleCall([(x = 1, y: number) => console.log(x + y)]);

objectCall(true && { run: (x = 1, y: number) => console.log(x + y) });
objectCall({ ...{ run: (x = 1, y: number) => console.log(x + y) } });
objectCall(({ ...{ ...{ run: (x = 1, y: number) => console.log(x + y) } } }));

function tagged(value: { kind: 'text'; run: (x: string) => void }): void;
function tagged(value: { kind: 'number'; run: (x: number, y: number) => void }): void;
function tagged(value: any) { value.run(2, 3); }
tagged({ kind: 'number', ...{ run: (x = 1, y: number) => console.log(x + y) } });
tagged({ ...{ run: (x = 1, y: number) => console.log(x + y) }, kind: 'number' });
tagged(true && { kind: 'number', run: (x = 1, y: number) => console.log(x + y) });

function mixed(value: { kind: 'text'; run: (x: string) => void; note: (x: string) => void }): void;
function mixed(value: { kind: 'number'; run: (x: number, y: number) => void; note: (x: number) => void }): void;
function mixed(value: any) { value.run(2, 3); }
mixed({ kind: 'number', note: (value = 1) => console.log(value), ...{ run: (x = 1, y: number) => console.log(x + y) } });
